description: Multi-defect type beam bridge dataset: GYU-DET is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ruiping Li et al. This paper proposes the GYU-DET dataset for bridge surface defect detection, aiming to address the limitations of existing datasets in terms of scale, annotation accuracy, and environmental diversity. The GYU-DET dataset includes six types of defects: cracks, spalling, seepage, honeycomb surface, exposed rebar, and holes, with a total of 11,123 high-resolution images. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2025. Formats: TXT, Image, ZIP. The data are held in Science Data Bank and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 40707255146 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
